reported.claim: The island counter is initialized to 1 instead of 0, causing the function to return one more than the actual number of islands.
reported.title: Island count starts at one

reported.claim: The function swaps the row and column indices after transforming the column, causing it to look up the wrong cell in the matrix.
reported.title: Row and column indices are swapped

reported.claim: Scalar multiplication casts the result to int, which truncates floating-point values and loses precision.
reported.title: Scalar multiplication truncates floats to ints

reported.claim: The maximum flow accumulator is decreased (`max_flow -= path_flow`) instead of increased, resulting in a negative flow value.
reported.title: Maximum flow is subtracted instead of added

reported.claim: The condition `if value in (True, None): return value` causes the function to return `None` if any literal is unassigned, even if another literal in the clause is already assigned `True`, which incorrectly marks a satisfied clause as unevaluated.
reported.title: Clause evaluation returns None on unassigned literal

reported.claim: The function mutates the input `model` dictionary instead of creating a copy before assigning new values, causing state to leak between recursive branches and leading to incorrect results or crashes.
reported.title: DPLL mutates shared model dictionary

reported.claim: The variable `leap_day_reinstall_number` is calculated using floating-point division instead of integer division, causing the subsequent modulo operations to produce incorrect results for years not divisible by 4.
reported.title: Easter calculation uses float division before modulo
